snippet: Apply the tourniquet high and tight on the limb, 2-3 inches above the wound if the wound location is known. Tighten until hemorrhage stops. Record the time of application on the casualty card and on the tourniquet itself.
title: TCCC — Tourniquet Application

snippet: If a person is bleeding heavily, press hard on the wound with a clean cloth. If bleeding does not stop, apply a tourniquet above the wound and get help. Do not remove the cloth to look — add more cloth on top.
title: Where There Is No Doctor — Hemorrhage

snippet: Water is one of the most important elements of survival. You can live for weeks without food but only a few days without water. Always purify water from natural sources before drinking: boil, filter, or chemically treat.
title: FM 21-76 — Survival

snippet: Connect the radio with an FTDI programming cable, select the correct COM port in CHIRP, and read from the radio before writing. Always save a backup image of the factory channels first.
title: CHIRP Programming Guide — Baofeng UV-5R

snippet: The high-voltage battery should be charged to 80 percent for daily use to preserve long-term battery health. Use the charge settings in the vehicle touchscreen or the FordPass app.
title: F-150 Lightning Owner's Manual

snippet: Low-acid foods must be processed in a pressure canner at 240-250 F to destroy Clostridium botulinum spores. Never use a boiling-water canner for low-acid foods.
title: USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning
